pw.name: Pacific Western (Pacific Flyway)
pw.bounds: Pacific Flyway Western Zone: all areas west of the Continental Divide not included in the Eastern Zone. Goose zone: the same Pacific Western zone.
pw.note: Pacific Flyway. Ducks Oct 3–20, Nov 6 – Jan 31; dark and light geese Oct 3–11, Nov 6 – Jan 31.

ne-bal.name: Northeast · Central Flyway balance
ne-bal.bounds: Central Flyway Northeast Zone: all areas east of Interstate 25 and north of Interstate 70. Goose: Balance of the Central Flyway: all areas east of the Continental Divide except North Park, South Park and the San Luis Valley.
ne-bal.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 17 – Nov 29, Dec 11 – Jan 31; dark geese Nov 2 – Feb 14, light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

se-bal.name: Southeast · Central Flyway balance
se-bal.bounds: Central Flyway Southeast Zone: all areas east of Interstate 25 and south of Interstate 70, and all of El Paso, Pueblo, Huerfano and Las Animas counties. Goose: Balance of the Central Flyway: all areas east of the Continental Divide except North Park, South Park and the San Luis Valley.
se-bal.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 28 – Jan 31; dark geese Nov 2 – Feb 14, light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

mf-bal.name: Mountain/Foothills · Central Flyway balance
mf-bal.bounds: Central Flyway Mountain/Foothills Zone: all areas west of Interstate 25 and east of the Continental Divide, except El Paso, Pueblo, Huerfano and Las Animas counties. Goose: Balance of the Central Flyway: all areas east of the Continental Divide except North Park, South Park and the San Luis Valley.
mf-bal.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 3 – Nov 29, Dec 25 – Jan 31; dark geese Nov 2 – Feb 14, light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

pe.name: Pacific Eastern (Pacific Flyway)
pe.bounds: Pacific Flyway Eastern Zone: all of Routt, Grand, Summit, Eagle and Pitkin counties; those portions of Saguache, San Juan, Hinsdale and Mineral counties west of the Continental Divide; Gunnison County except the North Fork of the Gunnison River Valley (GMUs 521, 53 and 63); and the part of Moffat County at Elkhead Reservoir State Park along Moffat County Road 29 (not drawn). Goose zone: the same Pacific Eastern zone.
pe.note: Pacific Flyway. Ducks Oct 3 – Jan 15; dark and light geese Oct 3 – Jan 6.

mf-sl.name: Mountain/Foothills · San Luis Valley
mf-sl.bounds: Central Flyway Mountain/Foothills Zone: all areas west of Interstate 25 and east of the Continental Divide, except El Paso, Pueblo, Huerfano and Las Animas counties. Goose: San Luis Valley goose zone: all of Alamosa, Conejos, Costilla and Rio Grande counties, and the portions of Archuleta, San Juan, Saguache, Mineral and Hinsdale counties east of the Continental Divide.
mf-sl.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 3 – Nov 29, Dec 25 – Jan 31; dark geese Oct 3–21, Nov 21 – Feb 14; light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

mf-sp.name: Mountain/Foothills · South Park
mf-sp.bounds: Central Flyway Mountain/Foothills Zone: all areas west of Interstate 25 and east of the Continental Divide, except El Paso, Pueblo, Huerfano and Las Animas counties. Goose: South Park goose zone: all of Chaffee, Custer, Fremont, Lake, Park and Teller counties.
mf-sp.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 3 – Nov 29, Dec 25 – Jan 31; dark geese Oct 3 – Jan 15, light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

mf-np.name: Mountain/Foothills · North Park
mf-np.bounds: Central Flyway Mountain/Foothills Zone: all areas west of Interstate 25 and east of the Continental Divide, except El Paso, Pueblo, Huerfano and Las Animas counties. Goose: North Park goose zone: Jackson County.
mf-np.note: Central Flyway. Ducks Oct 3 – Nov 29, Dec 25 – Jan 31; dark geese Oct 3 – Jan 15, light geese Oct 31 – Feb 14.

seasonsNote: Colorado is split between the Central Flyway (west of the Continental Divide is the Pacific Flyway). Each Central map zone is a duck zone (Northeast, Southeast, Mountain/Foothills) with a goose zone (North Park, South Park, San Luis Valley, balance); the Pacific zones (Western, Eastern) use one set of dates for ducks and geese. Teal, cranes, rails, snipe and doves are listed below.

Early Canada geese — Pacific Flyway (west of the Divide)
Sandhill cranes (east of the Divide except North Park and the San Luis Valley)

bags.detail: Central: 6 ducks and mergansers with no more than 5 mallards (2 hens), 3 pintails, 2 canvasbacks, 2 redheads, 3 wood ducks, 1 scaup. Pacific: 7 with no more than 2 hen mallards, 3 pintails, 2 canvasbacks, 2 redheads, 2 scaup (none after Jan 12, 2027 in the Western zone, Dec 27, 2026 in the Eastern zone).

Youth 17 or younger with a mentor 18+ (hunter education certificate or born before Jan 1, 1949) who may not hunt ducks, geese, mergansers or coots. Veterans and active military with documentation. Dark goose limit 5.

duckSublimits.note: no more than 2 hens; Pacific: 2 hen mallards, no other mallard limit
Pacific: none after Jan 12 (Western) or Dec 27 (Eastern)

rules.d: Chapter W-05 #504 limits waterfowl hunting on named state wildlife and park properties to designated hunt zones (up to six hunters per zone) by reservation; unoccupied reserved zones open first-come after 7:00 a.m. Read the property page. Not drawn.
East of the Continental Divide except North Park (Jackson County) and the San Luis Valley: Oct 3 – Nov 29, 2026, daily 3.
CPW’s proposal listed Feb 15 – Apr 30, 2027; the adopted Chapter W-05 text read for this build does not list it. Check CPW.
Northeast Oct 10–11; Southeast Oct 17–18; Mountain/Foothills and Pacific Eastern Sept 26–27; Pacific Western Oct 24–25, 2026.
Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

geometryNote: Geometry: the Central zones are routed on OpenStreetMap’s Interstate 25 and 70; the Pacific / Central line and the county-and-Divide splits use the USGS Continental Divide line; Census county lines; CPW’s GMU polygons for the Gunnison River valley exception. The Elkhead Reservoir piece of the Pacific Eastern zone (Moffat County Road 29) is not drawn. CPW managed properties, Walk-In Access tracts and boat ramps; USGS NHD (water; streams from NHDPlus HR) and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh); OpenStreetMap (roads). No tides.
